what_this_is: Did the GBM discovery reproduce in an independent glioma cohort?
replication_rule: direction first, then consistency across methods, then significance. A factor that reverses has not replicated whatever its p-value.

excluded_from_ranking.bisque: requires subjects assayed as BOTH bulk and single cells; Bisque's method IS the assay transform learned from paired subjects. Without overlap it estimates that transform from marginal distributions, which is its documented degraded mode. TCGA has no single-cell data, so this is not fixable from any file on disk -- it needs a genuinely paired cohort.
excluded_from_ranking.quantiseq: requires its own TIL10 signature and a matching gene space; quanTIseq ignores the supplied reference. It is reported separately wherever it runs, and it returned no finite estimates on either TCGA cohort.
excluded_from_ranking.scdc_ensemble: requires two or more references to weight across; With one reference there is nothing to ensemble; it reduces exactly to SCDC.
excluded_from_ranking.music: requires cross-donor variance (sigma) in the reference; MuSiC's entire contribution is weighting genes by cross-donor consistency. With a zero sigma it is residual-weighted NNLS, and returns numbers identical to NNLS.
excluded_from_ranking.epic: requires refProfiles.var (per-gene variance) in the reference; EPIC's published contribution is variance weighting. Without it the package warns and runs constrained least squares with uniform weights.
excluded_from_ranking.cibersortx_smode: requires the single cells the signature was built from; S-mode's batch correction is defined against the source cells; without them the method cannot run at all.

is_mesenchymal.why: Verhaak class does not exist for LGG; carried by the secondary MES score

gcimp.why: methylation phenotype not in MC3, and 0.868 correlated with IDH1 in GBM so not separately informative
